panels.title: Read the caveats before trusting these numbers

options.content:
- **Node duration is survivorship-biased (gap G-11).** `node_run.finished_at` is populated on 411 of 424 rows, and the 13 missing rows are *exactly the failures* — a failing node returns before `update_node_run_result` is called. So `ResponseBuilder p95` is computed over successes only and failures contribute nothing. A reliability regression can make this chart look *better*.
- **Flow duration uses `created_at` as a proxy** because `flow_run.started_at` is written on 0 of 87 rows. It therefore folds in plan-compile and dispatch time.
- **In-flight runs are not measurable.** `RunStatus.RUNNING` is never written on the in-process path, so the number would be permanently zero. See the placeholder panel at the bottom.

panels.title: Node duration p95 by node type (from spans)
panels.description: Span-derived, so it is NOT subject to the node_run.finished_at survivorship bias above.

panels.title: Node span error rate by node type
Execution funnel
panels.description: Reconciles exactly against the event stream today: flow_run 87 / node_run 424 / finished node_run 411 / finished flow_run 76. A divergence here means events and relational rows have drifted.

targets.rawSql:
select
  (select count(*) from flow_run fr join session s on s.session_id = fr.session_id where $__timeFilter(fr.created_at) and ('${tenant:csv}' = '$__all' or s.tenant_id::text = any(string_to_array('${tenant:csv}', ',')))) as "flow runs",
  (select count(*) from node_run nr join flow_run fr on fr.flow_run_id = nr.flow_run_id join session s on s.session_id = fr.session_id where $__timeFilter(nr.created_at) and ('${tenant:csv}' = '$__all' or s.tenant_id::text = any(string_to_array('${tenant:csv}', ',')))) as "node runs",
  (select count(*) from node_run nr join flow_run fr on fr.flow_run_id = nr.flow_run_id join session s on s.session_id = fr.session_id where nr.finished_at is not null and $__timeFilter(nr.created_at) and ('${tenant:csv}' = '$__all' or s.tenant_id::text = any(string_to_array('${tenant:csv}', ',')))) as "node runs finished",
  (select count(*) from flow_run fr join session s on s.session_id = fr.session_id where fr.finished_at is not null and $__timeFilter(fr.created_at) and ('${tenant:csv}' = '$__all' or s.tenant_id::text = any(string_to_array('${tenant:csv}', ',')))) as "flow runs finished"

select fr.canonical_status as metric, count(*) as value
from flow_run fr
join session s on s.session_id = fr.session_id
where $__timeFilter(fr.created_at)
  and ('${tenant:csv}' = '$__all' or s.tenant_id::text = any(string_to_array('${tenant:csv}', ',')))
group by fr.canonical_status
order by value desc

panels.title: Node runs by type and status

targets.rawSql:
select n.node_type, nr.canonical_status, count(*) as runs
from node_run nr
join node n on n.node_id = nr.node_id
join flow_run fr on fr.flow_run_id = nr.flow_run_id
join session s on s.session_id = fr.session_id
where $__timeFilter(nr.created_at)
  and ('${tenant:csv}' = '$__all' or s.tenant_id::text = any(string_to_array('${tenant:csv}', ',')))
group by n.node_type, nr.canonical_status
order by runs desc

panels.title: Stuck nodes (started, never finished)
panels.description: The only per-node failure attribution available until gap G-11 is fixed. These rows map 1:1 to FAILED flow runs today.

targets.rawSql:
select n.node_type, count(*) as stuck
from node_run nr
join node n on n.node_id = nr.node_id
join flow_run fr on fr.flow_run_id = nr.flow_run_id
join session s on s.session_id = fr.session_id
where nr.finished_at is null
  and $__timeFilter(nr.created_at)
  and ('${tenant:csv}' = '$__all' or s.tenant_id::text = any(string_to_array('${tenant:csv}', ',')))
group by n.node_type
order by stuck desc

panels.title: Edge decisions (routing quality)
panels.description: The sharpest product signal available today. Watch the ToolExecutor -> ToolErrorHandlerNode share: 43% of tool executions currently take the error branch. The payload does not carry the condition expression, so you see which branch won, not why.

targets.rawSql:
select
  coalesce(nfrom.node_type, 'unknown') as from_node_type,
  coalesce(nto.node_type, 'unknown') as to_node_type,
  (ee.payload->>'result')::boolean as taken,
  count(*) as evaluations
from execution_event ee
left join node nfrom on nfrom.node_id = (ee.payload->>'from_node')::uuid
left join node nto on nto.node_id = (ee.payload->>'to_node')::uuid
where ee.type = 'EdgeEvaluated'
  and $__timeFilter(ee.occurred_at)
  and ('${tenant:csv}' = '$__all' or ee.tenant_id::text = any(string_to_array('${tenant:csv}', ',')))
group by 1, 2, 3
order by evaluations desc
limit 50

panels.title: Flow version A/B cohorts
panels.description: Directional only: 11 of 17 cohorts currently have 2 or fewer runs and 4 have exactly one. Do not promote or roll back a version on this alone until cohort sizes grow.

targets.rawSql:
select
  fr.flow_version_id::text as flow_version,
  fr.flow_graph_snapshot_id::text as graph_snapshot,
  count(*) as runs,
  count(*) filter (where fr.canonical_status = 'COMPLETED') as completed,
  count(*) filter (where fr.canonical_status = 'FAILED') as failed,
  round(avg(extract(epoch from (fr.finished_at - fr.created_at)))::numeric, 3) as avg_seconds
from flow_run fr
join session s on s.session_id = fr.session_id
where $__timeFilter(fr.created_at)
  and ('${tenant:csv}' = '$__all' or s.tenant_id::text = any(string_to_array('${tenant:csv}', ',')))
group by 1, 2
order by runs desc

select repeats, count(*) as node_run_pairs
from (
  select nr.flow_run_id, nr.node_id, count(*) as repeats
  from node_run nr
  join flow_run fr on fr.flow_run_id = nr.flow_run_id
  join session s on s.session_id = fr.session_id
  where $__timeFilter(nr.created_at)
    and ('${tenant:csv}' = '$__all' or s.tenant_id::text = any(string_to_array('${tenant:csv}', ',')))
  group by 1, 2
) pairs
group by repeats
order by repeats

panels.title: Recent flow runs (click trace_id to open the trace)
panels.description: flow_run.trace_id is 87/87 populated and is a valid W3C 128-bit trace id, so this join into Tempo needs no schema change. This panel reads the grafana_flow_run VIEW, not flow_run: the read-only role has SELECT on flow_run.error, input and output REVOKED, because those columns embed the rendered system prompt, the user's message and their username.

targets.rawSql:
select
  fr.created_at,
  fr.flow_run_id::text as flow_run_id,
  replace(fr.trace_id::text, '-', '') as trace_id,
  fr.canonical_status,
  round(extract(epoch from (fr.finished_at - fr.created_at))::numeric, 3) as duration_seconds,
  fr.failure_reason,
  fr.failure_code
from grafana_flow_run fr
join session s on s.session_id = fr.session_id
where $__timeFilter(fr.created_at)
  and ('${tenant:csv}' = '$__all' or s.tenant_id::text = any(string_to_array('${tenant:csv}', ',')))
order by fr.created_at desc
limit 200

options.content: **Deliberately not a panel.** A concurrency gauge would need `flow_run.canonical_status = 'RUNNING'`, but RUNNING is only ever written by the Temporal `prepare_flow_run` activity and the resume path. On the in-process path it is never written, and the observed status distribution contains **zero** RUNNING or QUEUED rows. A gauge here would sit at zero forever and read as 'healthy, nothing queued'.
